followup_explanation:
This is a straightforward editing/writing task — improving the clarity and professionalism of a short procurement request. Nothing about it is harm-adjacent or ethically fraught, so the specialized moderation/desensitization profiles of the two models don't come into play here.

That left me to decide on raw capability. Dunlin-235B outperforms Lapwing-235B across essentially every relevant metric: higher Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4), higher IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6, which matters since the user gave specific instructions), and higher internal scores on the tasks closest to this request — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8) and Summarization (86.4 vs 80.3). Those gaps are well beyond the run-to-run variance threshold.

Given the user explicitly wants a genuine, high-quality rewrite (not superficial word-shuffling), routing to the stronger general-purpose model is the clear call.
